# Jobrow

> Public register of still-open US tech roles scraped from employer ATS boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever). Not a marketplace and not an employer.

Jobrow lists roles that are still open on the company board. Listings are US-tech filtered. Apply on the employer site.

## Site

- Home: https://jobrow.vercel.app/
- Search: https://jobrow.vercel.app/jobs
- Companies: https://jobrow.vercel.app/companies
- Closed roles: https://jobrow.vercel.app/closed
- About: https://jobrow.vercel.app/about
- Contact: https://jobrow.vercel.app/contact

## API (JSON)

- Open jobs: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/jobs
- Companies: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/companies
- Home digest: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/home
- Closed roles: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/closed
- Single job: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/jobs/{id}
- Company + roles: https://jobrow.vercel.app/api/companies/{slug}

## Optional

- Sitemap: https://jobrow.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Source: https://github.com/devtechedge/job-board

## Related

- Lattice (Web3 / crypto jobs): https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/
- Lattice source: https://github.com/devtechedge/lattice
